tasks.title: Explain today's work using construction terminology
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Give a short explanation of the work, using the correct site/bricklaying terms.

tasks.title: Share work information with another person
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Capture a witness/reflection showing what information was shared, why it mattered to the team goal and how it affected the wider build team.

tasks.title: Report a problem or change clearly
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain the problem, who you told, what action followed and any effect on the wider team.

tasks.title: Work as part of the bricklaying team
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a witness/reflection to show your role and how you contributed to the team goal.

tasks.title: Coordinate with another trade
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain what needed coordinating and how your work affected the other trade.

tasks.title: Help the wider team complete the task
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Describe the support/coordination given and the outcome.

tasks.title: Follow equality, diversity and inclusion guidance
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Give a short workplace example showing inclusive behaviour.

tasks.title: Communicate inclusively with others
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain how you adapted communication respectfully to the person/situation.

tasks.title: Support an inclusive team culture
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a witness/reflection describing how you helped keep the team respectful, inclusive and focused on the wider build goal.

tasks.title: Identify wellbeing support available
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Identify suitable support routes for yourself or others and when they should be used.

tasks.title: Support wellbeing on site
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Describe a safe, appropriate example of recognising/supporting wellbeing.

tasks.title: Record a learning or development activity
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain what you learned about standards, regulations or a modern construction method, why it matters to the role and what you will do differently.

tasks.title: Identify a modern method of construction
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show or describe the modern method/component and compare how it connects with the wider building compared with traditional masonry.

tasks.title: Explain how masonry connects with the wider building
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real detail to explain interactions with structure, insulation, fire, moisture, ties, lintels or services.

tasks.title: Learn and apply a new method or product
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain the new method/product, the standard or guidance used, source of information and how you applied it safely and accurately.
